read: Gamma family, available log link and variance proportional to squared mean, reviewed 2026-09-29.
implementation: Own fixed-shape Gamma positive conditional mean objective y/exp(eta)+eta, L2 slopes ridge.1/1 and unpenalized intercept; positive observed rows only, atmost12 Newton/backtracking steps. Fractional normalized expression is continuous.
controls: Same frozen dynamics/global detection, archived log-positive regression and quasi-Poisson ridge.1/1 joint predictions, unchanged full-panel scorer.
limitations: Only conditional mean fitting; no shape/dispersion estimation, sampling of Gamma observations, or calibrated biological uncertainty. Positivity support and constraints unchanged. Not a full generative model or published forecasting reproduction.
